get.description:
Searches Yelp businesses by name, category, or location. Required inputs: `query` and `location`. Results are paged: while `data.page.hasMore` is true, send `data.page.nextPage` as `page` to get the next page.

> **Request example pending verification.** The request example for this endpoint has not yet been verified in production. Static examples describe the request format; replace sample values with your own. Check the estimated price with a free quote request (`X-AISA-Cost-Mode: quote`) before running it.

schema.description: City, neighbourhood, postcode or address to search near.
Page number, starting at 1. Each page has up to 10 businesses.
Business name, service, or category to search for.
Result order. `recommended` is Yelp's default ranking. `highest_rated` and `most_reviewed` use Yelp's own sorts.

aisa_pagination.description: AIsa pagination. Pass next_cursor as page to fetch the next page; has_more is false on the last page.

X-AISA-Next-Cursor.description: Mirrors aisa_pagination.next_cursor; absent on the last page.
